issue.title: SvelteKit "params" prop warnings in console
issue.description: Multiple warnings about pages being created with unknown prop 'params' when navigating between pages
issue.impact: Console pollution with non-critical warnings, reduced developer experience

root_cause.description: SvelteKit automatically passes certain props (params, route, url, etc.) to page components, but Svelte warns about unknown props if components don't explicitly declare them

technical_details.point: SvelteKit passes internal props to all +page.svelte and +layout.svelte components
Components don't declare these props with 'export let params'
Svelte's compiler generates warnings for undeclared props
Current warning suppression in svelte.config.js is partially working but not catching all cases

affected_files.file: All other +page.svelte and +layout.svelte files in routes directory

current_state.point: svelte.config.js already has warning suppression logic
onwarn handler includes 'params' in internalProps array
Multiple regex patterns attempt to catch warnings
But warnings still appear in browser console

option.name: Enhanced warning suppression
option.description: Improve the onwarn handler to better detect and suppress these specific warnings
option.pros: Clean solution, no changes to components needed

option.name: Add export declarations
option.description: Add 'export let params' to all affected components
option.cons: Repetitive, requires changes to many files

recommendation.action: Enhance the warning suppression in svelte.config.js

steps.step: Analyze why current suppression isn't working
